channel.title: Welcome to the Thrill aka The Free Man
channel.desc: Kiwi Olympic freestyle skier Jossi Wells teams up with The Flying Frenchies to experience extreme sports like slacklining, wingsuit flying, and base jumping. The documentary explores the mental and physical challenges of these high-risk activities and the quest for freedom through fear. Directed by Toa Fraser. (R).
